members.name: orb_30min_volume_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 constituents on NSE (top 15 by liquidity)
members.thesis: The 30-minute opening range (09:15-09:45) is the most reliable ORB variant because it captures the full initial auction including mutual fund/FII order execution. Adding volume profile confirmation — the breakout must occur at or near the point of control (highest volume price) of the 30-min range —
entry_long: close > value_area_high (above value area — genuine break from accepted value)
members.exit_stop: POC_30 (point of control — if price returns to highest-volume area, thesis fails) OR 0.5 * ORB_range_30 inside range
filters: enter between 09:45-11:00 IST (breakout within ~75 mins of range completion)
NIFTY 50 direction aligned with breakout direction (macro tailwind)
weaknesses: 30-minute ORB provides a late entry (09:45 earliest); on strong gap days, the stock may already be 0.5-1.0% away from open, meaning much of the move is missed
Volume profile computation requires aggregating volume at each price level within 30 bars, which is data-intensive and may not be available via standard Zerodha API
The wider 30-min range means wider stops (compared to 5/15-min ORB), requiring more capital per trade to maintain the same risk-per-trade percentage
members.prior_art: Market Profile (Steidlmayer & Jones, 1988); Dalton et al. (2007) 'Markets in Profile'. ORB adapted from Crabel (1990) with Market Profile value area overlay.

members.name: orb_vwap_confirmation_v1
members.thesis: The standard ORB generates many false breakouts because it only considers price levels. Adding VWAP position as a confirmation filter — requiring price to be above VWAP for long breakouts and below VWAP for short breakdowns — filters for breakouts that have institutional flow support. VWAP represent
entry_long: ORB_VWAP_aligned_long == True (above ORB high AND above VWAP)
vwap_dev_bps > 5 (meaningfully above VWAP, not just touching)
ORB_high_15 > vwap (ORB high itself is above VWAP — strong structure)
entry_short: ORB_VWAP_aligned_short == True (below ORB low AND below VWAP)
ORB_low_15 < vwap (ORB low itself is below VWAP)
members.exit_stop: price crosses VWAP against position (above VWAP for shorts, below for longs) OR ORB_mid
filters: enter 09:30-10:30 IST; VWAP is more stable after 30+ mins of trading
VWAP slope positive for long entries, negative for short entries
weaknesses: The VWAP position filter eliminates valid breakouts that occur BEFORE VWAP has adjusted (early morning when VWAP is still near open price and may be above ORB_high temporarily)
Using VWAP as a dynamic trailing stop means the stop moves against the trade in strong trends (VWAP lags price), potentially giving back significant gains before the stop triggers
Dual confirmation (ORB + VWAP + 2-bar hold) significantly delays entry; by the time all conditions align, the breakout may be 15-25 bps from the ORB level, reducing reward
members.prior_art: Fisher (2002) VWAP-based trading; Crabel (1990) ORB. Combining ORB with VWAP is discussed in Dalton et al. (2007) but not formalized as a systematic strategy.

members.name: orb_15min_filtered_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 50 constituents on NSE (top 20 by liquidity)
members.thesis: The 15-minute opening range (09:15-09:30) provides a more reliable breakout level than 5-min ORB because it incorporates the full pre-open order matching and initial price discovery. Adding a VIX filter — only trading ORB breakouts when India VIX is between 13-20 — dramatically improves signal quali
members.exit_stop: ORB_mid (midpoint of 15-min range) OR 0.5 * ORB_range_15 back inside range
filters: CORE FILTER: India_VIX must be 13-20 at 09:30 IST; outside this range, no trades
enter between 09:30-10:30 IST (breakout within first hour post-range)
NIFTY 50 breaking out in same direction preferred (aligned ORB)
weaknesses: The VIX filter (13-20) eliminates ~35% of trading days, reducing signal frequency and capital utilization
The 2-bar confirmation delay means entering after the initial breakout bar; this can cause entry 5-15 bps above the breakout level, reducing the reward portion of risk-reward
On days where VIX is near the boundary (e.g., 12.8 or 20.3), the binary filter creates cliff effects — marginally excluded days may have good setups
members.prior_art: Crabel (1990) opening range breakout; Toby (1994) ORB with volatility filter. VIX conditioning inspired by Simon & Campasano (2014).
